note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L numbers and destinations (China, Colombia), so this is a real, active exporter — not a website claim. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 091020/091099 (spices: saffron, cumin etc.) does NOT match the observed cargo. All 5 visible records are HS 1211 (12119022 senna leaves, 12119029 eucalyptus leaves) — i.e. medicinal/botanical herbs, not spices. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual 1211 family (12119022 / 12119029) and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Caveat on identity: 'HARIOM INTERNATIONAL' is a very common Indian trade name; the ImportKey page aggregates records under this name and the visible rows are all herb exports from Mundra, so the link to the specific legal entity claimed (proprietor Pooja Rathi) is NOT independently verified — no CIN/PAN/GSTIN was visible on any page read. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in free views; ImportKey shows only shipment counts, no values). Domestic side: no traces of domestic supply found in the sources accessible, but this is an access limitation, not a negative finding — do not read it as 'no domestic supplies'.
